flavones in rice seeds are compartmentalized, highly conjugated and their synthesis genes are upregulated during germination.
flavones are important secondary metabolites for the plant life-cycle and could be beneficial to human health.

the seed is the only tissue where rice flavone synthesis occurs, and that this tissue-specific flavone metabolism is highly regulated during germination.
